info.title: HDX CKAN DataStore API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the CKAN DataStore API as exposed by the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).

## Tabular Data Endpoints

The HDX **Tabular Data Endpoints (TDE)** provide programmatic access to tabular datasets hosted on HDX. Powered by the CKAN DataStore extension, they support real-time querying, customizable filters, and dataset joins.

- **`datastore_search`** — simple filters, browsing data, or building lightweight applications
- **`datastore_search_sql`** — analytical purposes or when multiple conditions and calculations are required
- **`datastore_info`** — schema information about a resource, including column names and data types

Also covered: **`package_search`** for searching datasets in the HDX catalog.

CKAN actions accept parameters as either query string parameters (GET) or a JSON body (POST). Both methods are equivalent. All requests to HDX must include the `Authorization` header.

> **Note:** This specification documents behavior as described in the [CKAN 2.11 documentation](https://docs.ckan.org/en/2.11/maintaining/datastore.html). Some parameter interactions (e.g. `filters` vs `q` in `datastore_search`) have nuanced behavior that is not fully captured here.

get.description:
Query rows from a DataStore resource with optional filtering, full-text search, sorting, and pagination.

Pass parameters as query string arguments (GET) or as a JSON body (POST).

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: The `id` or alias of the resource to search. Required.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Matching conditions as a dictionary of `{field: value}` pairs. Rows must match all conditions. Example: `{"country": "Uganda"}`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query. Pass a string to search across all fields, or a dictionary of `{field: query}` to target specific fields. Note: behavior differs subtly from `filters` — `q` uses full-text ranking while `filters` performs exact matching.

parameters.name: full_text
parameters.description: Full-text search query applied across all fields. Similar to `q` with a string value, but always searches all fields. Cannot be combined with `q`.

parameters.name: distinct
parameters.description: Return only unique rows. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: plain
parameters.description: Treat the `q` query as plain text (no special FTS operators). Set to `false` to use PostgreSQL tsquery syntax. Defaults to `true`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language used for full-text search stemming. Defaults to `english`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to `100`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results. Used for pagination.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Columns to include in the response. Pass a comma-separated string or a list. Defaults to all fields.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by, with optional `asc`/`desc` direction. Example: `"fieldname1 asc, fieldname2 desc"`.

parameters.name: include_total
parameters.description: Include the total number of matching rows in the response. Defaults to `true`.

parameters.name: total_estimation_threshold
parameters.description: When `include_total` is `true` and the estimated row count exceeds this threshold, CKAN returns an estimated total rather than an exact count. Set to `null` (default) to always return an exact count.

parameters.name: records_format
parameters.description: Format for the returned records. `objects` returns a list of dicts, `lists` returns a list of lists, `csv` and `tsv` return delimited strings. Defaults to `objects`.

403.description: Forbidden — unauthenticated request, or the action is not permitted.

404.description: Not Found — the resource_id does not exist in the DataStore.

429.description: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Internal Server Error — unexpected server-side failure.

post.description: Identical to the GET form. Use POST to pass parameters as a JSON body, which is useful for large `filters` or `fields` payloads.

get.summary: Query a DataStore resource with SQL
get.description:
Execute a SQL `SELECT` statement against one or more DataStore resources. Useful for aggregations, joins, and complex filtering that `datastore_search` cannot express.

Only `SELECT` statements are permitted.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: A single SQL `SELECT` statement to execute against the DataStore. Required. Only `SELECT` statements are permitted — `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, and DDL statements are not allowed. Table names correspond to resource IDs (e.g. `SELECT * FROM "<resource_id>"`).

403.description: Forbidden — unauthenticated request, or the action is not permitted.

404.description: Not Found — the resource_id does not exist in the DataStore.

429.description: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Internal Server Error — unexpected server-side failure.

get.description:
Search for datasets (packages) using Solr query syntax. Supports filtering, faceting, sorting, and pagination.

Pass parameters as query string arguments (GET) or as a JSON body (POST).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Solr search query. Supports Solr syntax. Defaults to `"*:*"` (all datasets).

parameters.name: fq
parameters.description: Solr filter query. Restricts results without affecting relevance scoring.

parameters.name: fq_list
parameters.description: Additional filter queries as a list. Each entry is ANDed with `fq`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order as a Solr sort string. Defaults to `"score desc, metadata_modified desc"`.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Maximum number of datasets to return. Defaults to `10`, maximum `1000`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Offset into the result set. Used for pagination.

parameters.name: facet
parameters.description: Enable faceted results. Defaults to `"true"`.

parameters.name: facet.mincount
parameters.description: Minimum count for a facet value to be included in the response.

parameters.name: facet.limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of values returned per facet field. Defaults to `50`.

parameters.name: facet.field
parameters.description: Fields to facet on.

parameters.name: include_drafts
parameters.description: Include draft datasets in results. Requires authentication as the owning user or org admin. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Include deleted datasets in results. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: include_private
parameters.description: Include private datasets in results. Requires authentication as a member of the owning organisation. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: use_default_schema
parameters.description: Return results using the default package schema rather than any custom schema configured on the instance. Defaults to `false`.
